_comment: ALL generated snark for PlayaScope, consolidated into one file. English-only by policy — fr.json / es.json fall back here until a deliberate, idiomatic translation pass. Deep-merged into the `en` resource at load time (see src/i18n.ts), so keys still resolve under their normal namespaces (moop.tiles.*, battle.snark.*, …). To translate snark for a locale, create snark.<lang>.json with this same shape and register it in src/i18n.ts. Translate the JOKE, not the words — literal translation kills the punchline. Profanity is welcome and encouraged (see the MOOP tone). NEVER alter {{placeholders}} — the code fills them.

longestCamp.title: The camp name that would not shut up
longestCamp.how: Longest camp name across every burn. A committee fought over this. Click to open the burn.

topWord.title: The word every burner is legally required to use
topWord.detail: {{n}} times across {{titles}} event titles. Originality died on the playa and nobody held a funeral.
topWord.how: Lowercased event titles, stop-words yeeted, frequency counted.

topPrefix.title: The prefix that launched a thousand camps
topPrefix.detail: {{n}} camps opened with it. Runners-up: {{runners}}. Imagination: sold separately.
topPrefix.how: First word of each camp name, stop-words excluded.

varied.title: The absolute overachiever
varied.detail: Spread across every event type like a caffeinated maniac — variety score {{score}}/100. This burn physically cannot sit still.
varied.how: Even split across all 19 event categories = top score. Click to open the burn.

oneTrack.title: The gloriously one-trick pony
oneTrack.detail: One category, all damn week — variety score {{score}}/100. They know what they like and you will not move them.
oneTrack.how: Lowest spread across event categories (≥5 events).

allDay.title: Most events that technically do nothing, all day long
allDay.how: Count of events with all_day === true.

locationless.title: Most "good luck finding it, dipshit" events
locationless.how: No hosting camp, no host art, no other_location.

totalHours.title: Total programming this season
totalHours.detail: Every scheduled minute of every burn, stacked end to end. Nobody is sleeping. Nobody.

ifToday.title: If every burn on Earth happened today
ifToday.detail: {{camps}} camps · {{art}} art pieces all at once. Society would not survive — and honestly? Worth it.

weirdest.title: What in the actual fuck is this event
weirdest.detail: at {{burn}}. Runners-up: {{runners}}. Someone typed that stone-cold sober. Allegedly.

traveled.title: The DJ who has not seen their own bed since March
traveled.how: Distinct burns played, placeholder names (TBD/TBA/unknown) excluded.

overlap.title: The day you need to clone yourself
overlap.detail: On {{date}}: {{burns}}. Pick one. Disappoint literally everyone else.
overlap.how: Count of festivals whose date range includes each UTC day.

afterDark.title: The after-dark lexicon
afterDark.detail: {{n}} event titles got filthy. Also overheard: {{runners}}. The playa contains multitudes, and most of them are naked.
afterDark.how: Event titles matched against an adult-themed word list ({{terms}} terms). Bring an open mind.

spiciest.title: Horniest burn on the whole damn circuit
spiciest.detail: {{n}} Mature Audiences events — {{pct}}% of the entire program. {{total}} across the season. Hydrate, stretch, pace yourself.
spiciest.how: Count of events whose event_type is "Mature Audiences" — a real dust category.

reputation.title: Camps with a goddamn reputation
reputation.detail: Camp names that would make your mother nervous — e.g. {{sample}}. You know exactly which neighbourhood you're walking to tonight.
reputation.detailMore: Camp names that would make your mother nervous — e.g. {{sample}}, and plenty more. You know exactly which neighbourhood you're walking to tonight.
reputation.how: Camp names matched against the same {{terms}}-term adult word list.

fire.title: Burns that just slapped 'fire' on it and called it a day

notFire.title: Burns with the sheer imagination to NOT say 'fire'
notFire.how: Complement of the above. Brave souls.

artWalk.title: Longest art walk — wear better shoes, jackass
artWalk.detail: {{burn}} — {{count}} art pieces, {{steps}} steps, {{bananas}} bananas end to end. Your feet will be filing a formal complaint.
artWalk.how: Shortest path connecting every GPS-located art piece. 1 step ≈ 0.762 m, 1 banana ≈ 0.18 m.

snark.eventsRunaway: {{big}} runs {{ratio}}× the events of {{small}}. One of you will not sleep for a week; the other will be bored shitless by Tuesday.
snark.eventsClose: {{big}} barely edges out {{small}} — so close that arguing about it just makes you the asshole.
snark.art: {{big}} has {{bigArt}} art installations to the other's measly {{smallArt}}. Bring a wide-angle lens to one and a forgiving attitude to the other.
snark.music: {{big}} is the louder, sweatier night out — {{bigMusic}} music sets vs {{smallMusic}}. Pack earplugs or kiss your hearing goodbye.
snark.durationLonger: {{longer}} runs longer — {{longDays}} days vs {{shortDays}}. One's an endurance sport; the other you can actually explain to your boss.
snark.durationDenser: Same number of days, but {{denser}} crams more into every single one. Sleep was an option and {{denser}} said no thanks.
snark.regionSame: Civil war — both burns are in {{region}}. Someone is getting un-friended over this.
snark.regionDiff: {{regionA}} vs {{regionB}} — pack a passport and a really convincing excuse.
snark.sanctionBoth: Both card-carrying official BM regionals. The Org smiles upon this beautiful nonsense.
snark.sanctionNeither: Neither one's on the official list. Two gorgeous outlaws, zero adult supervision.
snark.sanctionOne: {{official}} has the official BM badge; {{other}} is out there doing whatever the hell it wants. Respect to both, frankly.
snark.vibeClash: Vibe clash: {{titleA}} is all {{traitA}}, {{titleB}} is all {{traitB}}. You already know which one your therapist would pick.
snark.vibeSame: Both burns share a hard {{trait}} streak. Twins separated at birth, raised by the same dusty cult.

traits.Performance: Look At Me, Look At Me

blurbs.noSleep: You will not sleep. You will not even sit down. Godspeed, you magnificent idiot.
blurbs.soundBowl: Everyone here owns a sound bowl and they are NOT afraid to use it on you.
blurbs.seeThings: You are going to see some shit. Hydrate first.
blurbs.practical: The most suspiciously well-organized burn on the circuit. Who hurt you? Who taught you logistics?
blurbs.kids: Bring the kids. No, seriously, actual children — it is that wholesome.
blurbs.parade: Hope you like parades, because congratulations, you are IN one now.
blurbs.subtle: A subtle little burn. Bring vibes; leave the flamethrower at home.
blurbs.noLearning: This burn does not fuck with workshops. Zero. Learning is for the default world.

snark.marathon: {{display}} played {{n}} burns ({{list}}){{distance}}. This person has not seen their own bed since spring.
snark.marathonDist: , {{km}} between the two furthest — that is not a tour, that is a fugitive
snark.placeholder: "{{display}}" is ranked #{{rank}} this season — {{burns}} burns, {{sets}} sets — and not one organizer can tell you who the hell that actually is. A legend made entirely of TBD.
snark.conflict: {{display}} is somehow at {{burnA}} AND {{burnB}} within 24h. Either a data gremlin or a genuine teleportation incident.

snark.noCommentary: no comment, honestly we are as surprised as you are

hourVibe.20: dinner, fire, and poor choices hour

snark.eggBrc: Put the phone down. You are at Burning goddamn Man. GO.
snark.eggAprilFool: There are no burns. There is no spoon. There is only dust.
snark.offSeason: Off-season. Go touch some grass, you beautiful dust-rat.
